tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Screen background behind grouped content: systemGroupedBackground.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, list rows, sheets: secondarySystemGroupedBackground.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Segmented tracks, neutral badges, thumbnail placeholders: systemGray5 / tertiary grouped.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons (label). 13:1 or better on ground and surface, just under 12.8:1 on surface-sunk in dark.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text (secondaryLabel, opaque). 4.7:1 or better on ground, surface and surface-sunk.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text (tertiaryLabel, translucent): absences ("not recorded"), panel titles, the empty-slot outline. Under 3:1, so never the only copy of a reading.

tokens.name: hair
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers (separator). Decorative only: never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Outlines of interactive controls (3:1 or better on ground and surface).

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: The system fill: gray buttons, off filter pills, hover and pressed rows. Translucent.

tokens.name: fill-hover
tokens.usage: The system fill one step stronger: hover on gray buttons.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The app's accent: Color.accentColor, System Blue by default; follows the person's accent on the Mac. Tints, selection, rings, marks.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Filled (borderedProminent) buttons: the accent stepped 20% toward black so white text passes 4.5:1.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and symbols on accent-fill.

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: Translucent accent tint: tinted (bordered) buttons, selected pills and rows.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent text on accent-wash or on any ground (4.5:1 or better): links, plain buttons.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Status: done, healthy, synced (system green, text step). Always with a word or glyph.

tokens.name: ok-wash
tokens.usage: Fill behind ok text.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Status: needs a look soon, stale, partial (system orange, text step).

tokens.name: warn-wash
tokens.usage: Fill behind warn text.

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: Warn text on warn-wash (4.6:1 or better).

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Status: failed, over limit, destructive (system red, text step). Never a high value on a data scale.

tokens.name: bad-wash
tokens.usage: Fill behind bad text.

tokens.name: heat-1
tokens.usage: Data scale, lowest step (calm, low urgency, slow bite). Marks only, 3:1 on surface. Claude Spinner's urgency ramp, darkened for light.

tokens.name: heat-2
tokens.usage: Data scale, second step. Marks only.

tokens.name: heat-3
tokens.usage: Data scale, third step. Marks only.

tokens.name: heat-4
tokens.usage: Data scale, top step (hottest, prime, most urgent). A scale value, not an error: pair with the scale's legend, never with an error message.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1, Apple mint. First, and the colour of a single-series chart. Light is the HIG Increased Contrast value (4.4:1 or better on surface), dark the default; both clear 3:1 as marks.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2, Apple purple. Light is the HIG Increased Contrast value (4.4:1 or better on surface), dark the default; both clear 3:1 as marks.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3, Apple blue. Reads as the accent; avoid beside accent controls. Light is the HIG Increased Contrast value (4.4:1 or better on surface), dark the default; both clear 3:1 as marks.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4, Apple pink. Light is the HIG Increased Contrast value (4.4:1 or better on surface), dark the default; both clear 3:1 as marks.

tokens.name: series-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5, Apple orange. Light is the HIG Increased Contrast value (4.4:1 or better on surface), dark the default; both clear 3:1 as marks.

tokens.name: chart-base
tokens.usage: Emphasis charts: every mark that is not the point (systemGray3). Under 3:1, so those marks carry a value label or sit beside a table.

tokens.name: chart-mid
tokens.usage: A lone series with nothing to single out (systemGray); hover on grey marks.

tokens.name: hl-purple
tokens.usage: Highlighted text in purple, as in Apple Notes: bold, on hl-purple-wash (4.5:1 or better in both themes). Also the ink of a purple tinted button.

tokens.name: hl-purple-wash
tokens.usage: The system purple at 10% (16% dark), translucent: highlight and purple tinted-button fill.

tokens.name: hl-purple-fill
tokens.usage: Filled purple button: 4.5:1 or better under hl-purple-on in both themes.

tokens.name: hl-purple-on
tokens.usage: Label on hl-purple-fill.

tokens.name: hl-pink
tokens.usage: Highlighted text in pink, as in Apple Notes: bold, on hl-pink-wash (4.5:1 or better in both themes). Also the ink of a pink tinted button.

tokens.name: hl-pink-wash
tokens.usage: The system pink at 10% (16% dark), translucent: highlight and pink tinted-button fill.

tokens.name: hl-pink-fill
tokens.usage: Filled pink button: 4.5:1 or better under hl-pink-on in both themes.

tokens.name: hl-pink-on
tokens.usage: Label on hl-pink-fill.

tokens.name: hl-orange
tokens.usage: Highlighted text in orange, as in Apple Notes: bold, on hl-orange-wash (4.5:1 or better in both themes). Also the ink of a orange tinted button.

tokens.name: hl-orange-wash
tokens.usage: The system orange at 10% (16% dark), translucent: highlight and orange tinted-button fill.

tokens.name: hl-orange-fill
tokens.usage: Filled orange button: 4.5:1 or better under hl-orange-on in both themes.

tokens.name: hl-orange-on
tokens.usage: Label on hl-orange-fill.

tokens.name: hl-mint
tokens.usage: Highlighted text in mint, as in Apple Notes: bold, on hl-mint-wash (4.5:1 or better in both themes). Also the ink of a mint tinted button.

tokens.name: hl-mint-wash
tokens.usage: The system mint at 10% (16% dark), translucent: highlight and mint tinted-button fill.

tokens.name: hl-mint-fill
tokens.usage: Filled mint button: 4.5:1 or better under hl-mint-on in both themes.

tokens.name: hl-mint-on
tokens.usage: Label on hl-mint-fill.

tokens.name: hl-blue
tokens.usage: Highlighted text in blue, as in Apple Notes: bold, on hl-blue-wash (4.5:1 or better in both themes). Also the ink of a blue tinted button.

tokens.name: hl-blue-wash
tokens.usage: The system blue at 10% (16% dark), translucent: highlight and blue tinted-button fill.

tokens.name: hl-blue-fill
tokens.usage: Filled blue button: 4.5:1 or better under hl-blue-on in both themes.

tokens.name: hl-blue-on
tokens.usage: Label on hl-blue-fill.

tokens.name: hl-purple-tint
tokens.usage: The system purple: what a purple tinted button mixes its hover wash from.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Web stand-in for Liquid Glass (with a 16px blur): toolbars and controls floating over content. In SwiftUI use .glassEffect() or .buttonStyle(.glass).

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: The 0.5px inner edge of glass.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Toasts and hints over content, white text.

tokens.name: music-accent
tokens.usage: Music's fixed red. Sidebar glyphs, text actions, the active queue icon, and CTA button fills. NOT the transport button, which is neutral, and NOT the favorited star, which measures gold. Only 4.35:1 on ground-window, so use music-accent-ink for text.

tokens.name: music-accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent TEXT, where 4.5:1 must hold. Music itself uses the raw accent here and fails AA; this is the one deliberate departure for the accent.

tokens.name: music-select
tokens.usage: Selected row fill while the window is key, with a white label. Not derivable from the accent: stepping the accent 20% toward black gives #C8253A, not this.

tokens.name: music-select-inactive
tokens.usage: Selected row fill when another app is frontmost. The normal state for a monitor app, so do not treat it as an edge case.

tokens.name: music-hover
tokens.usage: Row hover fill. Drawn as a rounded inset pill, 40pt in from each side of the row and ~6pt radius, never a full-bleed row.

tokens.name: music-primary
tokens.usage: The transport button (Play). Maximum contrast against the ground, so it inverts with appearance. Never the accent.

tokens.name: on-music-primary
tokens.usage: Label on music-primary. Inverts with it.

tokens.name: on-music-select
tokens.usage: Label on a selected row, white in both themes.

tokens.name: ground-window
tokens.usage: The Music window's content ground. Flat, not graded and not tinted by artwork. Differs from App Kit's iOS-derived ground, which is #000 in dark.

tokens.name: music-ink
tokens.usage: Primary text in the Music variant. Deliberately softer than App Kit's ink in both directions; do not inherit ink here.

tokens.name: music-ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text. Music measures #808080 in light, which is only 3.95:1 on white; #767676 is the first grey that clears 4.5. The second deliberate departure.

tokens.name: music-star
tokens.usage: The favorited star. Dark is MEASURED (#FFD700, sampled from album-detail-unfocused-dark.png, 11.74:1 on ground-window). Light is NOT measured: the same gold is 1.40:1 on white, far under the 3:1 a glyph needs, so light is stepped to the first gold that clears it. NOT the accent -- the star is gold, which is why the accent was taken from title strokes instead.

tokens.name: music-primary-inactive
tokens.usage: The transport button when the window is NOT key. Dark is MEASURED #2F2F30 from album-transport-inactive-dark.png; light is not measured and borrows music-select-inactive, the variant's other inactive fill. The button INVERTS rather than dims -- active is a light pill with a dark label, inactive is a dark pill with a light one. Its label is music-ink: measured #DFDFDF against music-ink's #DDDDDD, two units apart, which is a near-match not worth a second token. NOTE it is only 1.23:1 against ground-window, so the control's own boundary is near-invisible; that is Music's behaviour, not a target to copy.

tokens.name: on-music-glass
tokens.usage: Ink on the MiniPlayer capsule, which is a glass surface and not the window ground. Dark is MEASURED #FFFFFF from a Reduce Transparency capture -- every glyph, the title AND the artist line, all pure white, where music-ink would be #DDDDDD. Light is NOT measured and inherits music-ink's light value, so the departure is dark-only. Gated against ground-window as a conservative stand-in, because the capsule fill itself is only measured in dark.

tokens.name: music-ink-soft-on-fill
tokens.usage: Secondary text on music-hover or music-select-inactive. music-ink-soft reaches only 3.31:1 on the inactive selection fill and 3.99:1 on hover in light, so it is stepped here, the same split App Kit already makes between accent and accent-ink.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro", system-ui, sans-serif
families.display: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "SF Pro", system-ui, sans-serif
families.round: ui-rounded, "SF Pro Rounded", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: a hero number or a page headline. SF Pro Display.

styles.name: stat-lg
styles.usage: A single big figure the screen exists for. Pair with a caption unit in ink-soft.

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: Top-level screen title (iOS largeTitle).

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Detail screen title.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Section title inside a screen.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Panel title.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Row titles, emphasized body.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default reading text on Apple. Web pages may drop to callout.

styles.name: callout
styles.sample: Filter by camera, lens or date.
styles.usage: Web body copy and denser app text.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: Row subtitles, segmented-control labels (at 600).

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Secondary metadata, pill labels (at 600).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Chart axes, footers. Smallest size for sentences.

styles.name: caption-2
styles.usage: Chart ticks and the smallest labels, never sentences: .caption2.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: Panel titles, uppercase in ink-faint: .caption2.weight(.semibold) + .tracking(0.8) + .foregroundStyle(.tertiary).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase key above a value: stat tiles, table headers, badges. Always uppercase, never a sentence.

styles.name: value
styles.usage: Tabular figure in a stat tile.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Commands, paths, IDs.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Spaced capitals naming a figure or a slot: .caption2.monospaced().weight(.semibold) + .tracking(1.2), uppercased.

styles.name: fact
styles.usage: Fact values, so they line up down a panel: .system(.caption, design: .monospaced).

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Health-style big number: .system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded).bold().

styles.name: figure-md
styles.usage: Stat tile values: .system(.title, design: .rounded).bold().

styles.name: figure-sm
styles.usage: Values in a comparison: .system(.title2, design: .rounded).bold().

styles.name: script
styles.sample: I build the systems behind campaigns.
styles.usage: Long reading in SF Pro Text: .body with .lineSpacing(6).

styles.name: glance
styles.usage: watchOS and widgets only; SF Compact is the watch face.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-glyph nudges, hairline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside badges and flags.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between pills and chips; row inset (Footage Library row).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Pill side padding; gap inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding; minimum page gutter on phone.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Screen edge inset on iPad and desktop; gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: touch
tokens.usage: Minimum hit target for anything tappable (Apple HIG).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Thumbnails, badges, flags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, list rows, stat tiles, segments.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, sheets, map chrome (WA Fish Map).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons (capsules, as in iOS 26), filter pills, chips, toasts.

shadow.note: Almost none. Separate with surface against ground and hairlines, not shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-segment
tokens.usage: The active segment in a segmented control only.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Things floating over content: popovers, scrub previews, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Under glass controls, with the glass-edge ring.

motion.note: State changes on controls. Under prefers-reduced-motion they drop to none.

tokens.name: motion-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and press feedback. SwiftUI: .easeOut(duration: 0.15).

tokens.name: motion-ease
tokens.usage: The curve for every control transition: quick to respond, soft to settle.

stroke.note: Outlines that carry a state, drawn inside the edge. Separation between surfaces stays surface against ground.

tokens.name: stroke-outline
tokens.usage: State outlines: act and live panels, the empty slot, a selected filter pill, an attention tile. SwiftUI: .strokeBorder(color, lineWidth: 1.5).

tokens.name: stroke-dash
tokens.usage: The empty slot: 6 on, 4 off, in ink-faint. SwiftUI: StrokeStyle(lineWidth: 1.5, dash: [6, 4]).
